text:
Nora: Quick follow-up from this morning's all-hands about GPU supply signals and autoscaler behavior. Dropping notes + open questions.
Chen: Who has final sign-off to flip traffic cross-region?
Omar: Oncall lead + SRE make the go/no-go; infra executes routing changes.
Priya: Proposed automated trigger: sustained reserved GPU > 92% for 3m AND queue growth > 15% over 10m (2 consecutive EMA windows).
Felix: We should avoid noisy spikes. autoscaler uses EMA + require two windows to confirm.
Nora: Dedicated tenants need opt-out for region failover. config key: tenant_controls.allow_auto_region_failover (boolean). default=false for Dedicated.
Omar: Fallback sequence: 1) lower-power GPU profile, 2) increased batching window, 3) CPU fallback for background jobs, 4) rate-limited pass-through. chat workloads excluded from cpu-fallback by default.
Priya: Canary rules: 2% traffic for 15m; abort if latency +20% or top-k similarity drop >10%. pager to oncall + evals lead.
legal-bot: Will review customer comms for regulated accounts. ETA 48h.
infra-bot: Dry-run scheduled: fallback-dryrun-2026-06-09T09:00Z on staging (eu-central).
Nora: Action items: Nora->publish playbook PR, Chen->tenant docs, Omar->run dry-run and post logs, Felix->widget prototype for "supply risk".
Felix: I can mock the widget next week; supply_score = weighted(supply_signal, queue_len_norm, maintenance_flag).
Omar: If anyone wants to run a local test, ping me and I’ll trigger a dry-run in staging.
Chen: Please link PRs back here so we can close the loop. :thumbsup:
__notes: All-hands follow-up thread: playbook, triggers, tenant opt-out, canary rules, dry-run and comms for GPU supply and autoscaler failover
